title: Pacing row menu 'Move to previous/next week': the toast reads 'Moved to undefined.' and the hint names a week the row does not go to
detail: Pacing › w/c 2 Nov › In class 'Binary Trees & Graph Traversal' › ⋯. The menu offers 'Move to previous week · w/c 26 Oct — HALF TERM'. Choosing it moves the row to w/c 19 Oct (wb 2026-11-02 → 2026-10-19, wk 9 → 8) and the toast says 'Moved to undefined.' with Undo (Undo works). Reproduced twice on dense at mac. The same mismatch shows for a personal row whose neighbour is a school-only week (w/c 14 Dec, no personal number) or a break. A move that fails ({ok:false}) also toasts 'Moved to undefined.' because the result object is truthy. Should: the hint names the week the row will land in, and the toast names it too.
rootCause: js/modules/pacing.js:1491 and 1507 read res.toWb, but moveEntryWeek returns {ok, prevWb, prevWk, wb, addedWeek} (js/modules/pacing.js:275), so weekAt(undefined) is null; `if (res)` is true for {ok:false}. The hints come from allWks[wkIdx±1] (js/modules/pacing.js:1478-1481), every week including breaks and the other register's weeks, while moveEntryWeek steps through weekListFor(e.source) (js/modules/pacing.js:252).
evidence: eval /tmp rowmove.js on dense mac: items ['Move to previous weekw/c 26 Oct — HALF TERM','Move to next weekw/c 9 Nov',…], after [2026-10-19, 8], toast ['Moved to undefined.\nUndo'], undone [2026-11-02, 9]; /Users/fj/Developer/KurenaiOS-519/audit-evidence/2026-12/shots/productivity/pacing-rowmove-toast-mac-dense.png
fix: Use res.wb and test res.ok; compute each hint from the same list moveEntryWeek uses (export weekListFor or a pure `neighbourWeek(e, ±1)`), and say 'Adds a new week' only when that list ends. Undo of a move that added a week should drop the week again when it is empty.

title: A hidden Pacing row still counts in the exam scope, 'next in pacing', and the month/term/year reports' plan totals
detail: Hide is a soft delete that every derived read must leave out (invariant 84). On dense, hiding personal row p46 ('Programming constructs…', w/c 12 Oct, ref 4.1.1.2, the only row with that ref): carriedInto(23 Nov) drops 25 → 24 and entriesFor leaves it out, but KOS.exams.pacingCovered('2026-11-26','compsci') stays at 52 leaves (the hidden row still puts 4.1.1.2 in an exam's 'covered by the plan' scope) and KOS.exams.nextInPacing('compsci:4.1.1.2') still answers 2026-10-12. A month/term/year report counts hidden personal rows in 'planned' and 'carried' while the week report does not.
rootCause: Readers use KOS.pacing.entries() (every row, hidden included, js/core/pacing.js:621) instead of entriesFor or a filter on hidden: js/core/exams.js:214 (pacingCovered), 602-604 (covered by a ticked row), 611 (nextInPacing); js/core/report.js:1275 (planRows for month/term/year; the week path at 1273 uses entriesFor and skips hidden); js/core/examsession.js:484 and js/modules/examprac.js:614 likewise.
evidence: eval hidden.js on dense: before {cov:52,next:'2026-10-12',carried:25}, hidden {cov:52,next:'2026-10-12',carried:24,entriesFor:false}; js/core/report.js:407-413 (planned = rows.length)
fix: Give KOS.pacing a `visible()` read (entries().filter(e => !e.hidden)) and use it in every reader outside the page (exams.js, report.js, examsession.js, examprac.js, achcatalogue if wanted), or make entries() skip hidden and give the page an includeHidden option.

title: Pacing: 'Move up' / 'Move down' and the carried row's '→ here' write with no Undo, though every U4 row write is meant to have one
detail: Pacing › w/c 23 Nov › CS › My plan › first row ⋯ › Move down: the order changes (Encryption ↔ Hardware) and no toast or Undo appears (#toast empty). A carried row's '→ here' moves it from w/c 12 Oct to w/c 23 Nov and toasts 'Moved into w/c 23 Nov.' with no Undo button. Hide and Move to previous/next week do offer Undo. Reproduced twice each on dense, mac. '→ here' is the more costly one: the row's original week is no longer shown anywhere once it has moved.
rootCause: js/modules/pacing.js:1518-1525 (reorderEntry then redraw, no toast); js/modules/pacing.js:1654-1658 ('→ here': updateEntry({wb}) and a plain toast). Invariant 84: 'each write is one Undo'.
evidence: eval reorder.js (after order swapped, toast ''), undo2.js {hereToast:'Moved into w/c 23 Nov.', hereBtn:false, hereWb:['2026-10-12','2026-11-23']} on dense mac
fix: Toast with Undo on both, as Hide does: reorder Undo = reorderEntry(id, -dir); '→ here' Undo = updateEntry(id, {wb: oldWb}).

title: Calendar countdowns still count down to a showing you skipped ('Skip this showing' is ignored by nextOccurrence)
detail: Make a weekly Deadline due in 2 days (dense, harness), open it, Skip this showing for that date. occursOn(ev, that date) is false and the calendar grid drops it, but nextOccurrence still returns the skipped date, so Countdowns (the Calendar side card, Home, a subject's desk) still say '2 d' to 28 Nov instead of moving to 5 Dec. Opening that countdown row then shows the event as 'Skipped on Sat 28 Nov'. Reproduced twice (eval and again after cleanup).
rootCause: js/modules/calendar.js:444-463 nextOccurrence steps the rule arithmetically and never reads ev.skip or ev.ext.g.skip (occursOn does, js/modules/calendar.js:424-426); deadlines() (js/modules/calendar.js:506) and so countdowns() take its answer. Skip arrived in 1f251ebe (productivity#9).
evidence: eval skipcd.js on dense: {first:'2026-11-28', skip:['2026-11-28'], occursOnSkipped:false, next:'2026-11-28', cd:[['2026-11-28',2]]}
fix: In nextOccurrence, after computing a candidate, advance while the candidate is skipped (loop with occursOn or step again, bounded); the reminders' own nextOccurrence is separate and unaffected.
